description: Search Watchmode for movies and TV shows by name (or IMDb/TMDb ID via search_field); optionally filter by type (movie, tv_series, etc.). Returns Watchmode title IDs.

search_field.description: What search_value IS. Defaults to "name". Watchmode REQUIRES this and rejects anything outside the list — notably "title" is not valid.

name: title_search

outputSchema.description: Search results for titles from Watchmode API

title: Title Search
